output.sql: SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments AS p WHERE p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method
output.explanation: Counts payments by method based on arrival date (paid_at) in 2025, with their total amount in EUR. Amounts include shipping. They are cash received, not revenue, so payments for orders later returned are included (refunds are recorded outside this table). Payments received in 2025 for orders placed in 2024 are also included.
